scenario: The `sample <n>` time model (uniform-random reservoir, SeriesBackendReservoir backing) admits the statistical aggregations over the bag per LSER.16 / LSMP.3: mean, stdev, pXX, min, max, sum, count compile cleanly and need no accuracy phrase (the reservoir is count-bounded exact over the sample). Pin: a single `sample 200` observation line carrying the full admitted set compiles to the SeriesBackendReservoir backend.
rules_ds:
use default

schema Sensor scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    state: Float mutable

series Sensor.state:
    mean, stdev, p95, min, max, sum, count sample 200

rule trig:
    Sensor t where t.mean > 50
->
    log info "x"
